protokoll.gesetz.ja: Parliament adopts “{name}” {ort} ({ja} to {nein}). Now in force: “{stufe}”.
protokoll.gesetz.ja_warum: {text} Implementation takes about {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
protokoll.gesetz.nein_warum: The capital committed ({pk}) is lost and the government looks weakened. It lacked {fehlen} votes; withdrawing before the vote would have saved {gerettet} capital.
protokoll.haushalt.ja: Parliament adopts {titel} ({ja} to {nein}): {n, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} changed.
protokoll.haushalt.ja_warum: The deficit now stands at {defizit} % of GDP. The changes take effect immediately; the lasting effects unfold over the coming months.
protokoll.haushalt.nein_warum: Last year's budget continues: the items are set as a share of economic output and adjust for inflation automatically. The government looks weakened (legitimacy {legitimitaet}). It lacked {fehlen} votes.
protokoll.amtsantritt: Taking office. The economic data are as of {datum}.
protokoll.stat.wachstum: Growth in Q{q} {jahr}: {wert} % year on year.
protokoll.ziele_warum: At the end, the record measures how much of it was achieved.
protokoll.pump: You are acting on credit: political capital is negative.
protokoll.pump_warum: Whoever spends support in advance pays with legitimacy and trust until the monthly income balances the account.
protokoll.warnzeichen: Warning sign: approval remains very low.
protokoll.warnzeichen_warum: After six months below the threshold, the government risks being toppled.
protokoll.lager_verlassen_warum: Without the partners every vote becomes harder; breaking promises has a price.
belastung.zusammenbruch.chronik: The president collapses under the strain; days of enforced rest follow, and trust in the office and its circle suffers.
belastung.zusammenbruch.log: The president collapses under the strain.
belastung.zusammenbruch.warum: Weeks of overload take their toll: trust in the government −2, loyalty of the circle −6, an enforced break follows.
belastung.angespannt.chronik: Strain has risen above 40: estimates scatter more widely, some bills are delayed.
belastung.angespannt.warum: Strain has risen above 40. Attention recharges daily; keeping it above 60 reduces strain again.
belastung.beruhigt.chronik: Strain falls below 70; the president remains tense.
belastung.ueberlastung.chronik: Strain has risen above 70; the staff enforces quiet days without new matters.
belastung.ruhetag.log: The president needs a quiet day.
belastung.ruhetag.warum: Strain has risen above 70: until {datum} no new matters start; ongoing work continues.
abkommen.log.geschlossen_warum: Term {jahre} years. It takes effect every month, is reviewed every year and binds both sides.
abkommen.log.bestanden: Treaty with {land}: the annual review is passed.
abkommen.log.bestanden_warum: Türkiye has met all obligations: trust grows.
abkommen.log.gebrochen_warum: Missed: {verfehlt}. Trust collapses, and {land} will negotiate harder in future.
abkommen.log.verstoss_warum: Missed: {verfehlt}. A second time and the treaty counts as broken.
abkommen.log.ausgelaufen_gehalten: It was kept; that counts for a new treaty.
abkommen.log.ausgelaufen_verstoesse: There were violations; the country will remember them.
abkommen.log.gekuendigt_warum: Regular termination: a small loss of trust, no penalty.
abkommen.log.ausstieg_warum: Before a third of the term this counts as a breach: trust and standing fall, and the country will negotiate harder in future.
protokoll.vm.eingreifen: Ankara steps in: the guarantee between {namen} is enforced.
protokoll.vm.eingreifen_warum: Resolve costs 0.3 % of GDP and deterrence – but the guarantee holds, and everyone counts on Ankara.
protokoll.vm.daempfen: Violation of the agreement between {namen}: Ankara calms things down.
protokoll.vm.daempfen_warum: The violation is noted, not answered; the guarantee stands, but its deterrence suffers.
protokoll.vm.gebrochen_warum: A violation without response: the guarantor loses face (standing −6), the ripeness of the situation collapses.
protokoll.gp.schaetzblatt_warum: Entered freely (“{eingabe}”). Cost {pk} capital, construction {bau} points, {monate} months – ranges, not fixed prices.
protokoll.gp.verworfen_warum: The draft is off the table; the estimate was in vain, nothing was built.
protokoll.gp.umweg_warum: The veto stands; the route bypasses the country. Construction +{bau} %, time +25 %, debt +30 %.
protokoll.markt.eu_nachfrage_warum: The EU is the most important trading partner: exports and jobs in the industrial provinces suffer.
protokoll.markt.zinsen: The major central banks raise interest rates.
protokoll.markt.zinsen_warum: Investors pull money out of emerging markets: risk premium and lira come under pressure.
abk.grund.bruch: The memory of a broken treaty still weighs.
abk.grund.gegenseitig: A balanced package: give and take.
abk.grund.einseitig: You only demand without offering anything.
abk.urteil.zustimmung: {land} agrees: the treaty runs for {jahre} years.
abk.urteil.zustimmung_warum: Costs {pk} capital. It takes effect every month and is reviewed every year.
abk.urteil.gegenangebot_warum: Costs {pk} capital; accepting the counter-offer costs nothing more.
abk.urteil.veto_warum: Costs {pk} capital and some trust; the country will not talk to you for {tage} days.
abk.urteil.ablehnung: {land} declines: the package is too one-sided.
abk.urteil.ablehnung_warum: Costs {pk} capital; a new offer is possible in {tage} days.
abk.gekuendigt_warum: A small loss of trust; the lasting effects end.
abk.ausstieg: The treaty with {land} ended early: this counts as a breach.
abk.ausstieg_warum: Trust and standing fall; the country remembers.
abk.verl.verstoesse: {land} does not extend a treaty with violations.
abk.verl.vertrauen: {land} does not trust Türkiye enough for an extension.
abk.verl.ok: The treaty with {land} runs {jahre} years longer.
abk.leer: Without a game loop there are no negotiations.
abk.kein_kapital: There is not enough capital for this.
abk.gesperrt.laeuft: A treaty on this is already running.
abk.gesperrt.sperre: The trade, port and airspace embargo blocks this; it must first end by treaty (“Lift the trade and port embargo”).
abk.weg.kuerzer: {land} agrees if the term is shortened to {jahre} years.
abk.weg.tausch: {land} agrees if you drop “{verzicht}” and offer “{angebot}”.
abk.pruef.kein_land: There are no negotiations with this country.
abk.pruef.leer: A treaty needs at least one clause.
abk.pruef.doppelt: A clause can appear only once in a treaty.
abk.pruef.seite_gibt: Under “We offer” there is something we demand.
abk.pruef.seite_will: Under “We demand” there is something we offer.
abk.urteil.gesperrt: {land} will not talk to you again for {tage} days.
abk.urteil.gegen_weg: {land} no longer stands by the counter-offer.
abk.urteil.einig: {land} and Türkiye agree: the treaty runs for {jahre} years.
abk.grund.vertrauen_ja: Trust in Türkiye carries the talks ({v}).
abk.grund.streit: Open disputes weigh on the talks.
abk.grund.kein_streit: There is hardly any open dispute.
abk.urteil.einig_preis: The political price at home: {pk} capital.
